connections.why: Feynman's lectures teach Landauer's bound with a one-molecule gas and a piston, and cite the 2012 measurement this frame describes.
Computing's present-day frame sets the world's fastest machine against Landauer's kT ln 2: some ten thousand million times above it for each floating-point operation.
The same kT ln 2: Szilard charged it to the demon's measurement, Landauer to erasing a bit.
